testsuite.name: com.geoknoesis.trustweave.saas.server.billing.accountly.UsageDeliveryStoreTest

testcase.name: shared rate-limit capacity cannot be bypassed by concurrent new keys or duplicate upserts()
concurrent workers cannot own the same event and stale acknowledgements are fenced()
permanent rejections stop at the explicit poison budget()
redrive is audited and retains remote idempotency while refusing sent rows()
transient outages remain eligible beyond poison limit and respect retry time()
Spring transaction proxies commit claims and keep remote calls outside caller transactions()
